items.content_text: - **CFTC sues Utah to defend exclusive jurisdiction over event contracts on regulated exchanges, The Industry Spread reports** — The CFTC filed suit on October 26 in the District of Utah, announced in Release 9315-26, seeking to stop Utah from applying its gambling statutes to event contracts listed on designated contract markets. items.title: Australia regulator ASIC says prediction markets are highly speculative and not currently in the public interest for retail clients, Investor Daily reports
items.content_text: - **Australia regulator ASIC says prediction markets are highly speculative and not currently in the public interest for retail clients, Investor Daily reports** — ASIC chair Sarah Court said the regulator is not currently convinced prediction markets for retail clients are in the public interest, warning of market integrity, manipulation and outcome-dispute risks. No prediction market operator is authorised in Australia, and ASIC said the contracts share features with binary options, which are banned for retail clients until October 2031. ([Investor Daily](https://www.investordaily.com.au/asic-slams-highly-speculative-prediction-markets/))
